crop_convention: PIL left, top, right, bottom; right and bottom exclusive
modifications: Editorial square crop of panel D's whole-field image, excluding its border, and placement only; no recolouring, retouching, sharpening or spatial registration. Author red circles and arrow retained.

field_correspondence: Published Figure 2C/D and the retained first-full raw/result captures depict the same image-1 whole field in the same orientation. The lower soma, upper-right soma and diagonal chain of somas provide visual correspondence. Square whole-field crops displayed at equal physical widths give comparable field of view and magnification; this is not subpixel registration or contrast matching across authors.

matched_wholefield_layout.layout: Use equal square physical image bounds for all three crops, not the former wide native-detail bounds.
matched_wholefield_layout.limitations: The publication JPEG is a separately rasterized low-resolution result; exact subpixel registration is not established. The retained raw/result screenshots include a viewer annotation in the lower-right field; it must not be painted out. Colours are not shared cell identities and contrast/backgrounds differ.

reuse_status: Attributed manuscript draft comparison only; commercial journal reproduction permission/licence compatibility requires review before publication. No journal upload authorised.
